disclaimer: Educational planner only. Licence ages and university cut-offs move. Verify on the official site before acting.

rules.title: NSW assistant agent from 16; Class 2 licence from 18
rules.body: NSW assistant real estate certificate of registration from age 16 (Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 s14(3)). Individual property licence (Class 2) from 18 after required qualifications and typically >=12 months as assistant plus task log.

rules.title: ACT real estate licence is 18+
rules.body: ACT Agents Act 2003: an individual is eligible to be licensed as an agent only if the person is an adult (18+). Access Canberra issues licences.

rules.title: ACT has no standalone conveyancer licence
rules.body: ACT does not issue a standalone conveyancer licence. Conveyancing in the ACT is done by an Australian legal practitioner or by staff employed inside a law firm under that practitioner. A NSW conveyancer licence does not authorise standalone ACT practice. QLD has the same shape.

rules.title: NSW conveyancer from 18; cannot also hold a property-agent licence
rules.body: NSW conveyancer licence from 18, plus an approved qualification plus supervised experience. A person cannot hold a NSW property-agent licence and a conveyancer licence at the same time.

rules.title: CA Fundamentals from 18
rules.body: CA ANZ school-leaver CA Fundamentals from 18, requires completed high-school maths, university eligibility, and employment with an Approved/Recognised Training Employer. Still requires GradDipCA + 3 years mentored practical experience.

rules.title: TPB tax agent 18+ plus TASR item
rules.body: TPB registered tax agent: 18+, fit and proper, plus a TASR item (Item 201 typical for accounting graduates).

rules.title: Financial adviser personal advice path
rules.body: New-entrant path = Minister-approved degree + exam + professional year (~1600 hours). Paper-trading at 16 is allowed; calling him an adviser is not.

rules.title: Cookery Cert III + independent chef 18+
rules.body: SIT30821 Cert III, 48 service periods. Independent private-chef operations treated as 18+. Kitchen path must respect the allergy toggle.

rules.title: ACT ASbA 15+ part-time, not casual-only
rules.body: ACT ASbA: 15+, enrolled in an ACT school, part-time employment not casual-only. Max combined E/W VET units toward SSC minimum is 8.

rules.title: ACT Years 11-12 use BSSS
rules.body: ACT Years 11-12 use BSSS. Not the NSW HSC unless location mode is NSW-school. Gold Creek-style 7-10 schools are not the Year 11-12 campus.

rules.title: ANU needs a passed Year 11 or 12 maths unit
rules.body: ANU entry requires a passed Year 11 or 12 maths unit (plus English). Methods T is the default recommendation for commerce/finance/CA signalling.

rules.title: No default full overseas bachelor
rules.body: International = one exchange semester, or a later Masters, unless internationalStudy = full-degree.
